# git: alias: add del/delete with multi-type input

Add one `git del <thing>` that figures out what the argument is and deletes it. **Motivation:** "I'm so lazy to remember and use different commands to get things done":

```bash
$ git branch -D some/branch
# + remove remote branch (?)
$ git tag -d some-tag
# + remove remote tag (?)
$ git rm -rf some/path
# etc
```

instead:

```bash
$ git del some/branch
$ git del some-tag
$ git del some/path
```

The open questions in the note are the remote side — whether deleting a branch or tag locally should also delete it on the remotes, as [git_untag](../../bin/git_untag) does for tags — and disambiguation when a name is both a branch and a path.
